system.flavor:
Vanish against a wall while a patrol walks past, cross a courtyard unseen in daylight, sit in a crowded room and go unnoticed, get within arm's reach of a deer in the brush, or follow someone through a market all afternoon.

Not enough to disappear on open ground with nothing to blend into.

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy adjacent after moving up to 2 units from concealment.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage, or 2 if you began in concealment and the target had not detected you.

surges.html: After a hit, move 2 units back toward concealment without triggering its movement Reactions.

rider.title: Adaptation - Predator
rider.html: Assume Chromatophores (upkeep 0): while stationary in existing concealment, you may remain Hidden after observing enemies, but attacking still reveals you.
